title: Teach Me Your Paths

questions.question: To you, O Lord, I lift up my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:1 (ESV): "To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul."

questions.question: O my God, in you I trust; let me not be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:2 (ESV): "O my God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame;"

questions.question: Make me to know your ways, O Lord; teach me your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:4 (ESV): "Make me to know your ways, O Lord; teach me your paths."

questions.question: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:5 (ESV): "Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation;"

questions.question: Remember your mercy, O Lord, and your steadfast love, for they have been from of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:6 (ESV): "Remember your mercy, O Lord, and your steadfast love, for they have been from of old."

questions.question: Remember not the sins of my youth or my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:7 (ESV): "Remember not the sins of my youth or my transgressions;"

questions.question: Good and upright is the Lord; therefore he instructs sinners in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:8 (ESV): "Good and upright is the Lord; therefore he instructs sinners in the way."

questions.question: He leads the humble in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:9 (ESV): "He leads the humble in what is right, and teaches the humble his way."

questions.question: For your name's sake, O Lord, pardon my guilt, for it is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:11 (ESV): "For your name's sake, O Lord, pardon my guilt, for it is great."

questions.question: Who is the man who fears the Lord? Him will he instruct in the way that he should what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:12 (ESV): "Who is the man who fears the Lord? Him will he instruct in the way that he should choose."

questions.question: The friendship of the Lord is for those who fear him, and he makes known to them his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:14 (ESV): "The friendship of the Lord is for those who fear him, and he makes known to them his covenant."

questions.question: My eyes are ever toward the Lord, for he will pluck my feet out of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:15 (ESV): "My eyes are ever toward the Lord, for he will pluck my feet out of the net."

questions.question: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:21 (ESV): "May integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you."

questions.question: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25:22 (ESV): "Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles."

questions.question: Psalm 25 is an acrostic poem. True or False?
questions.explanation: Psalm 25 is an acrostic psalm where each verse begins with a successive letter of the Hebrew alphabet (mostly).

key_verse_text: Make me to know your ways, O Lord; teach me your paths.
